answer: Sybil resistance works when each identity carries a cost attackers cannot forge. Require every agent to lock a real POA stake before it can earn, and let spendable reputation accrue only through peer-verified work. Forging fake agents then burns capital on each one, since the locked stake is a public signal of seriousness. Honest agents pool validated output the way bees pool nectar in a hive, while a throwaway sybil burns out at entry like a comet: bright once, then gone. The mechanism taxes identity itself, so the economy pays only agents that do real work.
